headline: Banks led the week while *IT and metal slipped*
subline: Nifty rose 2.61% on the week. Friday's gain came with more decliners than advancers.
hero_text: Nifty gained 2.61% on the week and 1.12% on Friday, but 1,682 stocks fell against 1,046 that rose. The wider tape lagged the index.

why.title: Private banks set the pace
why.desc: Axis Bank rose 4.72% and Nifty Private Bank gained 3.01%.

why.title: Caution built under the rally
why.desc: India VIX rose to 17.32, near the top of its 21 session range.

why.title: Wider tape had no trigger
why.desc: 1,682 stocks fell against 1,046 that rose. No clear catalyst for the movers.

sector_reasons.PSU Bank: Topped the week on a steady lender bid
sector_reasons.Private Bank: Axis Bank led the Friday surge
sector_reasons.Metal: Tata Steel's slip weighed on the group
sector_reasons.IT: Bounced Friday but stayed lower for the week
sector_reasons.Pharma: Barely moved as hospital names took the bid

bonus_text: PSU banks led the week at 6.72% and Bank Nifty gained 5.9%. Metal fell 2.98% and IT 1.91%.
movers_note_gainers: Apollo Hospitals led at 5.29%. Axis Bank added 4.72% on the bank bid.
movers_note_losers: Titan fell 1.70%, the deepest cut. Tata Steel, NTPC and HUL also slipped.
watch_text: Monday is the Nifty weekly expiry. Open interest stacks at 26,000 calls and 24,500 puts, with max pain at 25,500.
lessons: Weight beat headcount. Banks lifted the Nifty while decliners outnumbered advancers.
The leader changed by the day. PSU banks topped the week, but private banks topped Friday.
A bounce did not repair the week. IT rose Friday but stayed lower for the week, as metal did.
Gains were not only banks. Hospital, auto and cement names also sat among the top Nifty gainers.
alert_text: Nifty weekly expiry falls on Monday 23 November. Max pain sits at 25,500, below Friday's close.
cta_headline: Banks won the week. *Expiry comes Monday*.
cta_sub: Full wrap every evening. Next bell is Monday 23 November.
next_text: Monday 23 November opens the new week. The F&O ban list adds MANAPPURAM and drops KAYNES.
caption_a:
Nifty rose 1.12% to 25,800.6 on Friday, yet 1,682 stocks fell against 1,046 that rose.
Bank Nifty gained 2.49%. FIIs bought Rs 10,308.42 Cr in cash while DIIs sold Rs 4,859.8 Cr.
Watch: Monday brings the Nifty weekly expiry, with max pain at 25,500.
